## Checklist

- [ ] Content is **quirky but mostly true** — surprising real facts, fun framing.
- [ ] Specific claims (dates, names, patent numbers) are accurate to the best of my knowledge.
- [ ] No copyrighted text or images. Any images are original or AI-generated and live in `public/images/`.
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds locally (or I'm relying on the build check).
- [ ] New articles are cross-linked to/from at least one other article.
